metaPublishedAdGuide.scope: Meta publishes these margins for Reels ads. This project also uses them as a conservative QA reference for organic Reels because the organic viewer has comparable interface overlays.

observedPublishedReel.calculation: At viewport height 1280, a 9:16 asset is 720 px wide. The 590 px viewport therefore removes 130 px in total, or 9.03% from each source side. 9.03% of 1080 is 97.5 px.

criticalContent.description: Headlines, subtitles, CTA, technology names, real logos and any object required to understand the claim.

supportingVisual.description: Non-critical diagram branches and large illustrative objects. They may enter UI pressure areas but must remain readable after the measured device crop.

rightActionRail.description: Observed Instagram interaction controls. Do not place text, logos or active diagram nodes here.

captionBand.description: Standard centered subtitle container straddling the 50/50 composition seam.

decorativeBleed.description: Background gradient, grid, light sweep, texture and non-semantic shapes only.

qaRule: The overlay is a review layer only. Never burn it into a delivery master. A visual pass is still required because pixel analysis cannot reliably distinguish decoration from critical content.
